prisma-unrepresentable.description: PostgreSQL INCLUDE columns on these covering indexes are not represented by the current Prisma schema syntax.
prisma-unrepresentable.remediation: Keep the exact reviewed operations until Prisma can model the covering indexes without losing INCLUDE columns.

schema-alignment-debt.description: Raw SQL retained database defaults and TIMESTAMPTZ semantics that Prisma can represent but the current schema does not declare.
schema-alignment-debt.remediation: Align @default and native-type annotations in a dedicated compatibility change, then remove the resolved operations.

missing-migration-debt.description: Database objects retained for two-phase removals are omitted by the compatible runtime schema but do not yet have their second-phase drop migrations.
missing-migration-debt.remediation: Add reviewed DROP COLUMN and DROP TYPE migrations only after confirming every deployed API role runs a compatible client; never edit applied migrations.
